note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_humor.py; type=manual require agent/render/sensitivity inspection.

gates.text: Slot ID assigned in AUD-OCC-PAIN format
Three candidate titles+subtitles drafted; each combined title+subtitle within 200 characters
Trademark check run on all three candidates; results recorded; no active conflict advances
Top-20 competitor scan completed on target marketplace; BSR, reviews, covers, price band, page counts, dates filed
One reachable Humor category and one Self-Help category confirmed with realistic top-100 entry
Slot scored on five-criteria rubric; proceed/justify/kill decision correct with no zero in Demand or Differentiation when proceeding
Seasonal window stated; manuscript-locked-by date stated; never launch inside final three weeks before peak
Kill-or-proceed decision written with one paragraph of reasoning; evidence record attached to state ledger and never discarded
Slot ID, final title, subtitle, marketplace, language confirmed
Audience segment assigned; exactly one humor register declared and locked for full manuscript
Body size and line spacing stated with reason; senior override (13-14pt, 1.5 spacing) applied when needed
Named mascot with five-line bible, or themed spot-art set; mascots vary across catalog within segment and language
Trim 6x9 confirmed; page target within 80-120; chapter count 8-12
Pen name sourced from fakenamegenerator.com in the format First Name, Initial(s). Surname
Three KDP categories stated; seven draft keywords stated, each under 50 characters
8-12 chapters; every chapter title is a joke that survives being read aloud; every subtitle a second joke
Localized header, ghost numeral, chapter number + middle dot + title, subtitle-joke line beneath; no page numbers
TOC fits one page up to 10 chapters, or two balanced pages at 11-12 chapters; built on Word machinery only
Dedication (max 30 words), Preface plan, How to Use plan, and Introduction plan stated; localized labels for non-EN
Half-title art page included
Copyright page has edition block, copyright line, all-rights text, humor disclaimer, imprint line, ISBN placeholder; all centered
Dedication humorous, maximum 30 words
Preface exactly one page, in-voice, ends on a welcome not a promise
How to Use exactly one page, left-aligned numbered anti-rules, ends 'that is the whole system'
No folios before Introduction; Introduction opens as printed page 1 with automatic PAGE field
Register held; no tonal drift from the locked register (fatal flaw)
At least one observational, one absurdist, one wordplay/misdirection, one situational; no device repeats in chapter
No banned humor: wine-mom, live-laugh-love mockery, stereotype/punching-down, dated memes, mother-in-law, protected-characteristic mockery
Quote page present, original joke, attribution as Name Initial./age/absurd job title, within 18 words, age 25-70
No alcohol, pork, or gambling-positive content in any element; comfort props tea/coffee/chocolate only
No stereotype harmful-reinforcement; Sensitivity Reader sign-off; segment guardrails satisfied
Per-chapter image quotas met (>=2 inline, >=2 spot, >=1 quote-page); every prompt numbered with mandatory constraints clause; each image carries a joke
Closing beat is warm permission, never cynical; the honest turn is one beat only, not instructional
Chapter body 600-900 words; all formatting via named styles only, no direct formatting
Conclusion exactly one page, permitted callback present, warm close
Author bio 60-90 words, in-voice, under pen name
Review request page: one final joke plus one honest, unincentivized, neutral ask
6x9, mirrored margins, gutter confirmed at final page count, fonts embedded, folios start at Introduction as page 1
Extent confirmed within 80-120 pages
Three cover candidates A/B/C with one-line rationales; typographic or hand-lettered; no icons, badges, or selling points on front
Front cover carries title and subtitle only; pen name on copyright page
Spine (100+ pages) title only top to bottom; back cover 3-5 in-voice hook lines, one line-art element, clear ISBN zone
No two catalog covers look alike; background and lettering variety confirmed
Listing description: hook, 3-5 joke bullets, interior-experience line, gift close, specs line; within 4000 characters
Seven keywords, one per 50-character field, from four pools; no trademarks, competitor names, or flagged terms
Price inside validated USD 7.99-14.99 band; computed royalty stated; never priced below band to chase rank
A+ plan (promise banner, interior peek, gift-occasion); interior preflight, wrap dimensions, metadata match, rights and AI-disclosure honest status
